approved_choices.identity: SQLite AUTOINCREMENT integer returned as a string; independent from Task.project
approved_choices.source_of_truth: Project content remains in Markdown. Only project bindings are stored in central SQLite.

implementation.project_store: One small Bun SQLite store with register/list/load, per-operation connections, readonly reads, BEGIN IMMEDIATE writes, and a 5000ms busy timeout.
implementation.registration: Validates an existing root and supported Backlog config without initialization/migration; canonical paths, duplicates and overlapping roots checked transactionally.
implementation.read_behavior: Missing database is an empty list; unknown IDs fail; invalid/unreadable databases are not rebuilt. Reads create no data directory or database.
implementation.cli: register/list/view with human-readable text and schemaVersion 1 JSON. Explicit paths resolve from terminal cwd; server commands bypass local project auto-migration.
implementation.simplicity_review: Existing FileSystem config parsing, directory normalization, CLI help/JSON conventions, and ProjectContextRegistry reused. No ORM, versioning framework, extra lock layer, unused edit/delete APIs, or source compatibility shims.
